verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-infrastructure platform offering ACH, cards and accounts, so the fraud-economics axis applies. The evidence pack never documents who bears losses from ACH return fraud, card disputes or account takeover, and it never describes fraud-prevention tooling. Mentions of card controls, real-time authorization and SOC 2/PCI compliance are adjacent features, not a documented liability split.

support.subject: As a finance lead, fraud economics are explicit — who eats ACH return fraud, card disputes, and account takeover losses, with the platform's prevention tooling documented alongside the liability split
